functions.name: get-activity-id-mapping
functions.description: Look up the current activity UUID corresponding to a legacy WHOOP activity ID.

legacyActivityId.description: Legacy activity ID as opaque decimal digits, not a timestamp.

FunctionInput_whoop_getactivityidmapping.description: Legacy WHOOP activity identifier to look up.

activityId.description: Current activity UUID; activity type is not supplied by this lookup.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getactivityidmappin.description: Current WHOOP activity identifier corresponding to the legacy ID.

tags.instructions: Use this when migrating a stored legacy activity ID. Use the returned UUID with `get-sleep` or `get-workout` when you already know the activity's type; the mapping does not identify that type.

functions.name: get-body-measurements
functions.description: Get the connected user's height, weight and WHOOP-calculated maximum heart rate.

FunctionInput_whoop_getbodymeasurements.description: No parameters are needed for the connected user.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate calculated by WHOOP for the user.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getbodymeasurements.description: The connected user's body measurements in SI units and WHOOP-calculated maximum heart rate.

tags.instructions: Use this for the current connected user's body measurements; no user ID is needed. Use `get-user-profile` for name and email. Maximum heart rate here is a user measurement, not a workout's observed maximum.

functions.name: get-cycle
functions.description: Get a physiological cycle and its available strain, energy and heart-rate measurements.

cycleId.description: Opaque cycle ID returned by list-cycles; decimal digits are preserved exactly.

end.description: Cycle end in UTC; absent for the current cycle.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate during the cycle.

averageHeartRate.description: Average heart rate during the cycle.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, in UTC.

stepCount.description: Steps; null means no data, distinct from zero or absence.

updatedAt.description: Last WHOOP update instant in UTC.

timezoneOffset.description: User offset when recorded, preserved separately from UTC instants.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getcycle.description: A physiological cycle and its available strain, energy and heart-rate measurements.

tags.instructions: Use a cycle ID from `list-cycles`. Use `get-recovery` or `get-sleep` for the cycle's recovery or sleep instead. An unfinished cycle can lack end and an unscored cycle lacks measurements.

functions.name: get-recovery
functions.description: Get the recovery associated with a physiological cycle and its available readiness and health measurements.

cycleId.description: Physiological cycle ID whose recovery should be returned.

FunctionInput_whoop_getrecovery.description: Physiological cycle whose recovery should be retrieved.

id.description: Recovery record key, equal to its cycle ID; not a separate provider recovery ID.

spo2Percentage.description: Blood oxygen percentage, omitted when unavailable.

userCalibrating.description: True while WHOOP lacks enough calibration data for accurate recovery.

restingHeartRate.description: Resting heart rate reported by WHOOP.

recoveryPercentage.description: Readiness to take on strain as a percentage, 0–100 scale.

skinTemperatureCelsius.description: Skin temperature in degrees Celsius, omitted when unavailable.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, in UTC.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getrecovery.description: Cycle-based recovery record and its available readiness and health measurements.

tags.instructions: Use a cycle ID from `list-cycles` or `list-recoveries`. Recovery is addressed by cycle, not by a separate recovery UUID. Use `list-recoveries` to browse. Pending or unscorable records have no score.

functions.name: get-sleep
functions.description: Get a sleep activity by its sleep ID, or retrieve the sleep associated with a known physiological cycle.

sleepId.description: Sleep activity UUID; use instead of cycleId when known.

cycleId.description: Physiological cycle ID whose associated sleep should be retrieved; use instead of sleepId.
Physiological cycle ID whose associated sleep should be retrieved; use instead of sleepId.

sleepId.description: Sleep activity UUID; use instead of cycleId when known.

FunctionInput_whoop_getsleep.description: Exactly one sleep activity UUID or physiological cycle ID to look up.

userId.description: WHOOP user who performed the sleep.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, in UTC.

timezoneOffset.description: Recorded user offset, preserved separately from UTC instants.

nap.description: True if the activity was a nap.

legacyActivityId.description: Previous-generation activity ID, only when WHOOP still supplies it.

recentNapMilliseconds.description: Reduction from recent naps in milliseconds; negative or zero.

recentStrainMilliseconds.description: Additional need from recent strain in milliseconds.

sleepNeeded.description: Signed sleep-need components in milliseconds; sum gives total sleep need.

inBedMilliseconds.description: Total time in bed in milliseconds.

noDataMilliseconds.description: Duration with no WHOOP data in milliseconds.

stageSummary.description: Sleep stage durations and event counts.

respiratoryRate.description: WHOOP respiratory rate during sleep, in the provider's reported rate unit.

sleepEfficiencyPercentage.description: Percentage of time in bed spent asleep, on a 0–100 scale.

sleepConsistencyPercentage.description: Sleep timing consistency percentage, omitted when unavailable.

sleepPerformancePercentage.description: Time asleep relative to sleep need as a percentage, omitted when unavailable.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getsleep.description: WHOOP sleep activity with UTC instants, exact identifiers, and available sleep evaluation.

tags.instructions: Use a sleep ID from `list-sleeps`, or a cycle ID from `list-cycles`; provide exactly one. Use `list-sleeps` to browse activities including naps. A pending or unscorable sleep has no score.

functions.name: get-user-profile
functions.description: Get the connected user's basic WHOOP profile, including name and email.

FunctionInput_whoop_getuserprofile.description: No input is needed; the connection selects the authenticated WHOOP user.

email.description: User email address as reported by WHOOP.

firstName.description: User's first name, preserving Unicode and empty text if supplied.

lastName.description: User's last name, preserving Unicode and empty text if supplied.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getuserprofile.description: The connected user's basic WHOOP profile.

tags.instructions: Use this to identify the connected user; no user ID is needed. Use `get-body-measurements` for height, weight and calculated maximum heart rate.

functions.name: get-workout
functions.description: Get a workout with its sport, interval and available strain, energy, distance, altitude and heart-rate-zone measurements.

workoutId.description: UUID of the workout to retrieve.

userId.description: WHOOP user who performed the workout.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, in UTC.

updatedAt.description: Last WHOOP update instant in UTC.

timezoneOffset.description: Recorded user offset, preserved separately from UTC instants.

sportName.description: WHOOP sport name, preserved as reported.

strain.description: WHOOP cardiovascular strain on a 0–21 scale.

averageHeartRate.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute.

recordedPercentage.description: Heart-rate data received by WHOOP, percentage on a 0–100 scale.

distanceMeters.description: Distance travelled in meters, omitted when unavailable.

altitudeGainMeters.description: Total upward travel in meters, excluding descents; omitted when unavailable.

altitudeChangeMeters.description: Signed end-minus-start altitude difference in meters, omitted when unavailable.

zoneZeroMilliseconds.description: Milliseconds in zone 0, very light activity.

zoneFourMilliseconds.description: Milliseconds in zone 4, very hard activity.

zoneDurations.description: Milliseconds spent in each heart-rate zone.

FunctionOutput_whoop_getworkout.description: A workout with its sport, UTC interval, identifiers and available measurements.

tags.instructions: Use a workout UUID from `list-workouts`. Use `list-workouts` to browse instead. Unscored workouts have no score; distance and altitude may be absent even for scored workouts.

functions.name: list-cycles
functions.description: List one page of the connected user's physiological cycles, newest start first, optionally restricted by time.

end.description: Exclusive upper time bound using WHOOP's intersecting-or-ended-before semantics; omitted means now on the first page.

limit.description: Maximum cycles in this page; defaults to 10.

start.description: Inclusive minimum occurrence time with explicit UTC marker or offset; omitted means no minimum.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool for the same connection, filters and limit; omit for the first page.

FunctionInput_whoop_listcycles.description: Time filters and continuation for one page of physiological cycles.

end.description: Cycle end instant in UTC; absent for the current unfinished cycle.

score.description: WHOOP evaluation, present only when scored.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate during the cycle.

averageHeartRate.description: Average heart rate during the cycle.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, normalized to UTC without precision loss.

stepCount.description: Steps during the cycle; null means no step data, distinct from zero and absence.

updatedAt.description: Last WHOOP update instant in UTC.

scoreState.description: Whether measurements are available, pending, or cannot be scored.

timezoneOffset.description: Recorded user offset, preserved as Z or signed hh:mm; not an IANA timezone.

items.description: A physiological cycle and its available measurements.
Cycles in this page in descending start-time order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation; absent when WHOOP supplies no next token.

FunctionOutput_whoop_listcycles.description: One page of physiological cycles and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover cycle IDs and browse cycles. Use `get-cycle` for a known ID. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters and limit to continue. Each call returns one page; limit is 1–25, default 10.

functions.name: list-recoveries
functions.description: List one page of the connected user's recoveries, newest related sleep first, with optional time bounds.

end.description: Exclusive upper instant using WHOOP's intersecting-or-ended-before semantics; defaults to now on first page.

limit.description: Maximum recoveries in this page, default 10.

start.description: Inclusive minimum occurrence instant; omitted means no minimum.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same connection, filters and limit.

FunctionInput_whoop_listrecoveries.description: Optional time bounds, page size and continuation for browsing recoveries.

id.description: Recovery record key equal to cycleId, not a distinct provider ID.

userCalibrating.description: True while calibration data is insufficient.

restingHeartRate.description: Resting heart rate reported by WHOOP.

skinTemperatureCelsius.description: Skin temperature in degrees Celsius when available.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, in UTC.

items.description: A recovery and its available WHOOP evaluation.
Recoveries ordered by related sleep start descending.

nextCursor.description: Continuation; absent when WHOOP has no next token.

FunctionOutput_whoop_listrecoveries.description: One page of recoveries and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this to browse recoveries and obtain cycle IDs for `get-recovery`. Pass nextCursor as cursor with unchanged filters and limit to continue. Limit is 1–25, default 10. Each call returns one page.

score.description: WHOOP sleep evaluation, absent unless scored.

recentStrainMilliseconds.description: Additional need from strain in milliseconds.

sleepNeeded.description: Signed millisecond components whose sum gives sleep need.

respiratoryRate.description: Respiratory rate in WHOOP's reported rate unit.

sleepEfficiencyPercentage.description: Percentage of in-bed time spent asleep, 0–100 scale.

sleepConsistencyPercentage.description: Timing consistency percentage; omitted when unavailable.

sleepPerformancePercentage.description: Time asleep versus need percentage; omitted when unavailable.

functions.name: list-workouts
functions.description: List one page of the connected user's workouts, newest start first, with optional time bounds and available evaluations.

end.description: Exclusive upper instant with WHOOP's intersecting-or-ended-before semantics; defaults to now on first page.

limit.description: Maximum workouts in the page; defaults to 10.

distanceMeters.description: Distance travelled in meters; omitted when unavailable.

averageHeartRate.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute.

altitudeGainMeters.description: Upward-only altitude gain in meters; omitted when unavailable.

recordedPercentage.description: Heart-rate data received as a percentage on a 0–100 scale.

altitudeChangeMeters.description: Signed net altitude change in meters; omitted when unavailable.

createdAt.description: Time recorded in WHOOP, in UTC.

timezoneOffset.description: Recorded user offset, preserved separately from UTC instants.

items.description: A workout with available WHOOP measurements and evaluation.

functions.name: revoke-user-access
functions.description: Revoke the connected user's WHOOP access token and stop this OAuth client's configured webhooks for that user.

FunctionInput_whoop_revokeuseraccess.description: Revoke access for the connected WHOOP user without additional parameters.

revoked.description: WHOOP accepted access revocation; not a claim that health records were deleted.

FunctionOutput_whoop_revokeuseraccess.description: Acknowledgement that WHOOP accepted access revocation for the connected user.

tags.instructions: Use only to disconnect the user's WHOOP access. This invalidates access used by the connection and stops this client's webhooks for the user; it does not delete WHOOP health records. No confirmation field is needed. The user must authorize again to regain access.
